title: Analista Risco Crédito JR
description:
Job description

Dedicamo-nos a oferecer soluções de mobilidade que proporcionem experiências únicas por meio de nossos produtos e serviços. E isso só é possível porque temos uma equipe incrível , com brilho nos olhos e vontade de realizar .

É assim que fazemos acontecer! Inspirados pelo Poder dos Sonhos e movidos pelas crenças fundamentais da nossa Filosofia: #respeito ao indivíduo , #iniciativa , #igualdade e #confiança , temos contribuído para tornar a Honda uma empresa única, inovadora e desejada pela sociedade.

AHondavaloriza aDiversidade e Inclusão e tem um olhar que engloba o respeito e aceitação das pessoas por meio do reconhecimento das diferenças e da singularidade de cada um, podendo referir-se a gênero, raça, etnia, nacionalidade, idade, orientação sexual, deficiência, característica física, crença religiosa, perspectiva política, status social entre outros.

“Somos uma empresa focada no ser humano, movida pelo sonho de criar e pelo espírito dos desafios” Soichiro Honda

Se você se identifica conosco e deseja fazer parte deste time, vamos iniciar esta jornada!

Main responsibilities

Seu dia a dia transita por atividades multidisciplinares e desafios tais como:

  • Apoiar na manutenção e documentação das políticas de crédito da empresa;
  • Acompanhar indicadores operacionais e de performance relacionados ao processo de concessão;
  • Auxiliar na análise de dados e identificação de oportunidades de ajustes nos critérios de aprovação;
  • Participar de testes e simulações de novas regras ou estratégias de crédito;
  • Apoiar na comunicação e disseminação das políticas para áreas de negócio, operação e tecnologia.

Requirements and skills

O que buscamos em você:

  • Conhecimento em métricas de crédito, como inadimplência, carteira ativa, aprovação/reprovação, entre outras;
  • Capacidade de analisar dados de performance e apoiar na formulação de propostas de melhoria em políticas de crédito;
  • Noções de modelos estatísticos ou de score de crédito;
  • Compreensão básica do ciclo de crédito e etapas de concessão;
  • Experiência prévia em áreas relacionadas a risco de crédito, análise de crédito, concessão ou acompanhamento de carteiras;
  • Experiência com análise de base de dados e relatórios de performance de crédito;
  • Graduação: Administração, Engenharia, Estatística ou Matemática;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Office intermediário;
  • Conhecimento em SQL e Power BI.

O que será um diferencial:

  • Participação em projetos de melhoria de políticas, análise de indicadores de crédito ou processos de crédito automatizados;
  • Cursos complementares: Crédito e Cobrança, Análise de Risco, Estatística Aplicada ou Data Analytics;
  • Certificações em Excel avançado, SQL ou fundamentos de Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em Python ou R.

Additional information

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Honda São Paulo (próximo ao shopping Morumbi). Vaga no modelo presencial de trabalho.

Informações adicionais:

Nos preocupamos com o seu bem-estar, por isso oferecemos os seguintes benefícios, os quais revalidaremos em sua jornada, pois variam de acordo com a localidade:

  • Nossa Jornada de Trabalho tem carga horária flexível e banco de horas para usufruir sempre que precisar;
  • Oferecemos Vale Refeição, Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Vale Transporte, Auxílio Creche para as mamães, estacionamento, Wellhub e a PreviHonda;
  • Programas de desenvolvimento e conexão tais como Saúde e Bem-estar;
  • Descontos em nossos produtos Honda;
  • Bônus anual;

Mais sobre nós:

Presente no Brasil desde 1971, a Moto Honda da Amazônia Ltda é atualmente a maior fabricante de motos do país, com mais de 27 milhões de unidades produzidas em Manaus (AM). Desde 2001, a empresa produz também motores estacionários e motobombas, além de comercializar a linha de motores e máquinas no país.

Em 1992, com a criação da Honda Automóveis do Brasil Ltda. , a empresa entrou no mercado automotivo brasileiro.

Faz parte do grupo também a Honda Serviços Financeiros , que reúne o Consórcio Nacional Honda , a corretora de Seguro Honda e o Banco Honda, que facilitam o acesso dos clientes aos produtos da marca.

Durante esses anos a empresa também inaugurou Centros Educacionais de Trânsito, de Treinamento Técnico, de Distribuição de Peças e de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento , além do seu próprio parque eólico no sul do país.

title: GERENTE DE PRICING - MATRIZ - SÃO PAULO/SP
description:
Job description

Responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de sortimento, organização de produtos e políticas de precificação nas lojas, alinhadas ao planejamento da empresa e ao comportamento do shopper, com foco na rentabilidade e na experiência do cliente. Atua na definição e gestão de preços competitivos, por meio da análise de mercado, acompanhamento da concorrência e desenvolvimento de índices de competitividade. Lidera programas de monitoramento de preços e envia informações estratégicas ao time comercial, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões assertivas e garantindo o posicionamento competitivo da marca.


Main responsibilities

  • Desenvolver, estruturar e implementar a estratégia de pricing da empresa, alinhada aos objetivos de rentabilidade, crescimento e posicionamento competitivo no mercado.
  • Gerenciar o sortimento e a organização dos produtos em loja de acordo com diretrizes estratégicas, comportamento do shopper e performance de categorias, visando aumento de conversão e lucratividade.
  • Monitorar continuamente os preços praticados pela concorrência, por meio de pesquisas de mercado, ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de dados, assegurando a competitividade da empresa.
  • Criar, manter e aprimorar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e índices de competitividade de preços, garantindo visibilidade e controle das ações de pricing.
  • Identificar oportunidades de reposicionamento de preços, elasticidade de demanda e mix de produtos, a fim de maximizar margens e volume de vendas.
  • Propor ajustes de preços com base em análises financeiras, comportamento do consumidor, tendências de mercado e estratégias da concorrência.
  • Apoiar o time comercial na definição de estratégias por categoria, faixa de preço e perfil de loja, promovendo ações coordenadas entre pricing, compras e operações.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de campanhas promocionais e políticas de descontos, garantindo alinhamento com as metas de rentabilidade.
  • Liderar projetos de inovação na área de pricing, incluindo automação, uso de inteligência artificial e ferramentas analíticas para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Assegurar a integridade, consistência e atualização das bases de dados utilizadas nas análises e na precificação dos produtos.
  • Treinar e orientar equipes envolvidas nos processos de pricing, garantindo a aplicação correta das políticas e estratégias definidas.
  • Realizar apresentações gerenciais com diagnósticos, análises e recomendações para os diferentes níveis da liderança da empresa.

Requirements and skills

  • Superior Completo, preferencialmente nos cursos de Administração, Comunicação, Contabilidade, Gestão Financeira, Gestão Comercial;
  • Conhecimento Avançado no Pacote Office: Word, Ênfase em Excel, Power point;
  • Conhecimento de pesquisas em loja;
  • Entendimento de marketing;
  • Domínio - Processo de Gerenciamento de Categorias;
  • Conhecimento em precificação;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de negociação.

Additional information

Modalidade 100% presencial - Vila Leopoldina - ZO/SP

description:
PALO IT is a global technology consultancy that crafts tech as a force for good. We design, develop and scale digital and sustainable products and services to unlock value across the triple bottom line: people, planet, profit. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We're proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

We are entrepreneurs and passionate experts: We invest in what we believe genuinely and work as a collective intelligence

We are positive, courageous, caring, doers and committed to excellence

Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrate with SOAP and HTTP-based web services.

Manage and optimize relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL.

Write and maintain automated unit and integration tests to ensure code quality and functionality.

Use Git for source code management and collaborate through agile development processes.

Ensure systems are capable of handling high performance and large-scale real-time processing needs.

Contribute to continuous improvement, code quality standards, and development best practices.

Who You Are

3+ years of experience with Node.js for back-end and React for front-end development

Hands-on experience with APIs, Web Services (SOAP, REST, HTTP)

Experience designing microservices or serverless architecture

Proficient with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL

Comfortable with Git and version control workflows

Experience building robust automated test suites (unit and integration)

Exposure to high-performance, real-time systems

Working knowledge of Python

Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools

Experience in event-driven architectures (RabbitMQ or similar messaging platforms)

Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, etc.)

More About PALO IT

We’re eager to adapt to change, learn from our experiences and move to meet our planet’s urgent needs. We are continuously taking action to:

Deliver projects with a positive impact

Train 100% of our workforce on impact

Achieve B Corp certification among all our offices across the globe

Continuously measure & improve employee happiness

Our clients are amongst the world's most successful companies. We innovate with both established Fortune 1000s, SMEs and start-ups who aim to make an impact, become global leaders and address the world's most complex challenges.

PALO IT is an equal opportunity employer that values merit, qualifications, and abilities. We prioritize privacy and data security. For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

Como Analista Comercial SR , você será responsável por atuar como parceiro estratégico da área comercial, com foco na análise de dados, inteligência de vendas e geração de insights acionáveis para impulsionar resultados no canal Atacado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo (Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas);
  • Excel avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, análises complexas);

  • Domínio do Pacote Office, com foco em: Excel (avançado): análises de indicadores e controle de performance e PowerPoint: construção de apresentações executivas e planos comerciais;
  • Capacidade de leitura e análise de KPIs e relatórios de mercado;
  • Raciocínio lógico e habilidade com modelagens de dados e construção de cenários.

  • Ambiente de trabalho integrado, alegre e positivo.
  • Horário flexível, para driblar os horários de pico!
  • Vale-Refeição para bater aquele papo legal e descontraído com os seus colegas enquanto degusta as iguarias.
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico e seguro de vida para garantir o seu bem-estar e o da sua família. Mente sã em corpo são, sempre.

Do you know Bunge?

Distributed in more than 40 countries, a world leader in oilseed processing and one of the largest producers and suppliers of vegetable oils, fats, and proteins for more than two centuries, Bunge works to connect farmers to consumers to provide essential food, ingredients, and fuels for the world. With 117 years in Brazil, we have more than 100 units and are one of the main agribusiness and food companies, a leader in grain origination and soybean and wheat processing. In all our value chains, we promote our business while supporting the social and economic well-being of the communities where we operate.

We value the diversity of our teams and seek creative talents with team spirit and a desire to make a difference. In everything we do, we put our values into practice:
• Act as one team, promoting inclusion, collaboration, and respect;
• Seek excellence, being agile, innovative, and efficient;
• Do what is right, acting in a safe, ethical, and sustainable manner.

At Bunge, we value diversity in all its forms and work towards an inclusive and belonging culture with respect and equity. Here, everyone is welcome as they are!

Our company has a solid track record, and we are building a future full of opportunities! Be part of our team and follow your professional journey with us.

Role Purpose

Global Payroll Compliance and Excellence Manager is responsible for providing strategic direction and support on global payroll for approximately 23,000 employees in 44 countries across the globe (Asia, Americas, and Europe). This role is responsible for ensuring, in partnership with HR regional leaders and BBS, accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll processing across all regions, managing payroll policies, and enhancing payroll systems and processes. This manager will work closely with cross-functional teams and regional payroll teams to implement and support on global standards processes, maintain compliance with varying regulations, and drive continuous improvement within payroll operations and T&A harmonization/standardization. The position will also support on vendor management to ensure payroll accuracy and compliance in multiple countries

Main Accountabilities

  • Support developing and implementing global payroll strategies, policies, and best practices to ensure efficient, timely, accurate and compliant payroll operations.
  • Support Global Payroll Transformation and M&A´s integration.
  • Support Time & Absence Transformation.
  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track payroll accuracy, efficiency and compliance, including payroll and tax reconciliation, identifying and recommending opportunities to improve tax-related processes and systems to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with international, federal, state, and local payroll regulations, including tax filings, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Implement controls to mitigate risks associated with payroll processing, including data integrity, fraud prevention, and regulatory compliance.
  • Partner with internal and external auditors to address audit requirements and resolve any compliance issues.
  • Facilitate training and communication with regional payroll teams on policies, processes, and changes in payroll regulations.
  • Partner with HR global functions to build and implement global processes, e.g. payroll mobility control, salary publishing, bonus publishing and respective activities transition to BBS.
  • Establish partnerships with third party vendors to ensure effective service delivery, and support HR regional leaders on manage them

Knowledge and Skills

  • Make decisions aligned to Bunge’s global strategy, business needs and financial goals and explore new perspectives by driving innovation.
  • Cultivate strong relationships and networks, effectively influence others, and develop talent to excel in their current and future roles.
  • Develop data driven strategies aligned with Bunge’s priorities, energize others to action through clear and compelling communication.
  • Clear understanding of HR operational excellence, global payroll, organizational alignment
  • Strong communications and presentation skills, the ability to make the complex, detailed information clear and actionable, as well as strong influence management skills to the alignment and commitment
  • Excellent problem-solving and conflict resolution capability
  • Experience driving projects to a successful completion, and ability to work in a global environment
  • HR operations and payroll best practices and processes knowledge
  • Knowledge of labor legislation overall
  • GDPR (data privacy) knowledge

Education & Experience

  • Degree in business management, Human Resources or related discipline in an equivalent education
  • Experience with HR Operations, payroll and/or any other HR role
  • Experience with end-to-end M&A activities
  • Experience managing large vendors and contracts
  • Focus on customer service
  • Excellent written communication and numerical skills
  • Ability to work within tight and conflicting timeframes
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance and driving results
  • Ability to handle confidential information and sensitive matters
  • Fluent English language skill (Spanish is desired)

Global Talent Attraction | Employer Branding

Patria is, at its core, a resilient and entrepreneurial partnership that continually assesses the environment, identifies trends, and adapts quickly to capture new opportunities. For over 35 years, we have been recognized as a regional and sector specialist in alternative asset management, with a strong commitment to ethical values and long-lasting impact for all our stakeholders.

About the Role

We are seeking a Program Manager (Associate level) to lead and manage our Early Careers Recruitment, Trainee Programs, and Employer Branding projects. This role is pivotal in shaping Patria’s early talent pipeline and strengthening our employer brand across Latin America and beyond. You will partner closely with universities, internal stakeholders, and external vendors to attract, engage, and develop high-potential students and early career professionals who align with our long-term talent needs and organizational culture.

This position is based in our São Paulo office and follows a full in-person work model. We are looking for local talent!

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end management of early careers recruitment programs, including Patria Academy (internship and trainee programs), ensuring alignment between recruitment partners, hiring managers, HRBPs, and other stakeholders.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve structured recruitment processes for early talent, from needs assessment and sourcing strategy to candidate selection, onboarding, and program engagement.
  • Oversee external recruitment consultancies, ensuring service-level quality, process adherence, and alignment with Patria’s priorities and values.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations to enhance Patria’s presence and attract top early career talent.
  • Drive employer branding initiatives focused on early careers, including digital campaigns, university events, and social media engagement to promote Patria’s culture and opportunities.
  • Provide comprehensive staffing support and market intelligence to management teams, leveraging leading-edge recruiting techniques and tools.
  • Own KPI management and data analytics for all early careers programs: define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (such as time to hire, cost to hire, diversity of hires, program conversion rates, and candidate experience metrics) to identify trends, measure program effectiveness, and drive data-driven decision making.
  • Prepare and present regular reports and actionable insights to leadership, recommending improvements based on data analysis.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and processes, maintaining accurate records and influencing hiring managers regarding their compliance responsibilities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders and HR partners, proactively engaging leadership teams to establish a common understanding of Talent Acquisition policies, processes, and service level agreements.
  • Creatively brand and promote Patria’s culture, maximizing social media and digital presence for talent branding and engagement.

Main Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in program or project management within recruitment, early talent programs, or employer branding, preferably with exposure to both corporate and search firm environments.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes, including partnership with external vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in KPI management and data analytics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of university recruiting cycles, early talent best practices, and employer branding strategies.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a structured, disciplined manner.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or data analytics tools is highly desirable.

At Patria, we believe that how we achieve our goals is as important as the results themselves. Our way of working is a key differentiator, helping us retain the best team, build long-term relationships, and generate superior returns. We are:

  • Ethical and aligned to our clients’ objectives
  • Associative, complementary, and united by a purpose
  • Disciplined, criteria-driven, and hands-on

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Strategic Account Executive role at Canonical

Continue with Google Continue with Google

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Strategic Account Executive role at Canonical

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Talent Acquisition Project Manager role at Patria Investments

Patria is, at its core, a resilient and entrepreneurial partnership that continually assesses the environment, identifies trends, and adapts quickly to capture new opportunities. Our team is made up of high performers who combine expertise with a hands-on approach, fostering trusting relationships with clients and delivering consistent results. For over 35 years, we have been recognized as a regional and sector specialist in alternative asset management, with a strong commitment to ethical values and long-lasting impact for all our stakeholders.

About the Role

We are seeking a Program Manager (Associate level) to lead and manage our Early Careers Recruitment, Trainee Programs, and Employer Branding projects. This role is pivotal in shaping Patria’s early talent pipeline and strengthening our employer brand across Latin America and beyond. You will partner closely with universities, internal stakeholders, and external vendors to attract, engage, and develop high-potential students and early career professionals who align with our long-term talent needs and organizational culture.

This position is based in our São Paulo office and follows a full in-person work model. We are looking for local talent!

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end management of early careers recruitment programs, including Patria Academy (internship and trainee programs), ensuring alignment between recruitment partners, hiring managers, HRBPs, and other stakeholders.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve structured recruitment processes for early talent, from needs assessment and sourcing strategy to candidate selection, onboarding, and program engagement.
  • Oversee external recruitment consultancies, ensuring service-level quality, process adherence, and alignment with Patria’s priorities and values.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations to enhance Patria’s presence and attract top early career talent.
  • Drive employer branding initiatives focused on early careers, including digital campaigns, university events, and social media engagement to promote Patria’s culture and opportunities.
  • Provide comprehensive staffing support and market intelligence to management teams, leveraging leading-edge recruiting techniques and tools.
  • Own KPI management and data analytics for all early careers programs: define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (such as time to hire, cost to hire, diversity of hires, program conversion rates, and candidate experience metrics) to identify trends, measure program effectiveness, and drive data-driven decision making.
  • Prepare and present regular reports and actionable insights to leadership, recommending improvements based on data analysis.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and processes, maintaining accurate records and influencing hiring managers regarding their compliance responsibilities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders and HR partners, proactively engaging leadership teams to establish a common understanding of Talent Acquisition policies, processes, and service level agreements.
  • Creatively brand and promote Patria’s culture, maximizing social media and digital presence for talent branding and engagement.

Main Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in program or project management within recruitment, early talent programs, or employer branding, preferably with exposure to both corporate and search firm environments.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes, including partnership with external vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in KPI management and data analytics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of university recruiting cycles, early talent best practices, and employer branding strategies.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a structured, disciplined manner.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or data analytics tools is highly desirable.

At Patria, we believe that how we achieve our goals is as important as the results themselves. Our way of working is a key differentiator, helping us retain the best team, build long-term relationships, and generate superior returns. We are:

  • Ethical and aligned to our clients’ objectives
  • Associative, complementary, and united by a purpose
  • Disciplined, criteria-driven, and hands-on
  • Committed to fostering a high-performance environment

Diversity & Inclusion

Patria is committed to equal opportunity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. All employment decisions are based on individual merit and organizational needs

Sobre a companhia:
A Minor Hotels possui, administra e opera um portfólio diversificado de mais de 530 hotéis, resorts e residências de marca em seis continentes. A MINT também é conhecida por suas marcas internacionais de varejo e estilo de vida, e sua subsidiária, Minor Food Group, é uma das maiores empresas de restaurantes do mundo, com mais de 2.100 pontos de venda em 20 países.
Para informações adicionais, acesse: a marca:
Uma das marcas da Minor Hotels, a Tivoli Hotels & Resorts foi fundada em 1933, com a abertura do Tivoli Avenida Liberdade Lisboa, um dos hotéis mais emblemáticos da cidade de Lisboa, Portugal. Com mais de 85 anos de experiência, a Tivoli diferencia-se através de um portfólio de propriedades únicas e autênticas, com personalidades distintas, partilhando um ambiente elegante e intemporal, refletindo o savoir faire de gerações de hoteliers.
A Tivoli faz parte do grupo hoteleiro Minor Hotels e atualmente opera mais de 20 propriedades em Portugal, Brasil, Espanha, Itália, China, Holanda e Qatar. Tanto em cidades cosmopolitas, refúgios românticos ou praias idílicas, a Tivoli convida-o a viver como um local nestes destinos, em luxuosos hotéis contemporâneos ou históricos, recebendo seus hóspedes e clientes de forma calorosa e genuína.
Sobre o hotel:
O Tivoli Maiorana chega a Belém para celebrar a união entre a rica história da cidade e a excelência da hospitalidade Tivoli. Localizado no coração da capital paraense, o hotel convida cada hóspede a vivenciar uma experiência única, onde a tradição amazônica se encontra com o conforto e a sofisticação contemporânea. Belém, a "Metrópole da Amazônia", é uma cidade vibrante, com um patrimônio histórico e cultural riquíssimo. O Tivoli Maiorana Belém Pará está estrategicamente situado para que se possa explorar os encantos da cidade, desde o icônico Mercado Ver-o-Peso, com suas cores e sabores exóticos, até o centro histórico, com seus casarões coloniais e igrejas seculares.
O Tivoli Maiorana Belém oferecerá uma variedade de opções gastronômicas em seus restaurantes e bares, celebrando a diversidade da culinária local e internacional. Além disso, o hotel contará com o restaurante Seen Belém no rooftop, proporcionando uma vista panorâmica da cidade. Para relaxamento, o Anantara Spa oferecerá tratamentos inspirados na tradição tailandesa e na natureza amazônica, e uma academia moderna estará disponível para os hóspedes, além de piscinas para momentos de lazer.
No Tivoli Maiorana, cada detalhe está sendo cuidadosamente pensado para proporcionar uma estada inesquecível. Seja para uma viagem de lazer ou de negócios, o Tivoli Maiorana Belém Pará representa o ponto de partida perfeito para explorar as maravilhas de Belém. Descubra a beleza da Amazônia, a riqueza da cultura paraense e a sofisticação da marca Tivoli em um destino encantador.

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos com análise de processos voltados à automação, especialmente utilizando RPA.
  • Sólido conhecimento da plataforma UiPath (Studio, StudioX e Orchestrator) para entendimento e validação de soluções.
  • Experiência em mapeamento e documentação de processos , utilizando BPMN ou ferramentas similares.

  • Experiência em projetos com integrações via APIs RESTful .

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Inglês intermediário/avançado, com capacidade de leitura de documentação técnica e comunicação com equipes internacionais.
  • Certificações UiPath (ex: UiPath Certified RPA Associate ou superior).
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) aplicadas a projetos de automação.

Soft Skills que valorizamos

  • Proatividade e espírito colaborativo.
  • Boa comunicação, com habilidade para dialogar com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Pensamento crítico e foco em soluções que agreguem valor ao negócio.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes na documentação e análise de processos.

Suas principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar e mapear processos de negócio junto aos stakeholders para identificar oportunidades de automação.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional e técnica dos processos e soluções a serem automatizadas.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de desenvolvimento para garantir que as soluções atendam aos requisitos de negócio.
  • Realizar validações e testes funcionais das automações desenvolvidas.
  • Conduzir apresentações, workshops e reuniões de levantamento com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho das automações implantadas, sugerindo melhorias contínuas.
  • Apoiar na priorização e roadmap de iniciativas de automação com foco estratégico.

Would you like to help shape Baker Hughes' Sourcing Strategies?

Advance your career

About the team

Our Oilfield Equipment business provides intelligent, connected technologies to monitor and control our energy extraction assets and supporting facilities. Our team arranging technical expertise to meet our client expectation. We provide customers with the peace of mind needed to reliably and efficiently improve their operations.

Partner with the best

To manage the buying process for a given set of goods. Apply sourcing policy, interface between supplier and entity with respect to specifications and budgets. To manage overall regional strategy for the product company in LAM & NAM.
Positions requiring thorough understanding and application of approaches, theories, methodologies and application in a concrete organizational context.

· Being responsible for manage, place and follow-up on POs. Manage relationships with suppliers for PO execution. Manage problems and schedule changes;

· Handling communication with direct colleagues and the business about design and coordination services rendered;

· Contributing to project as a team member or leads small projects.

Fuel your passion

· Have Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college;

· Have experience in Buying-Procurement;

· Have experience in Supply Chain (related to well head items)

· Be able to communicate fluently/ native in Portuguese;

· Be able to communicate in English (intermediate);

· Have 10-15% of the time available to travel;

· Lead initiatives of moderate scope and impact. Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

· Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

title: Vendedor I (Consultor de Vendas de Serviços) – RP 16875 (16875)
description:
Vendedor I (Consultor de Vendas de Serviços) – RP 16875

Sistema Fiep é sinônimo de fortalecimento da indústria. Trabalhamos de forma integrada, visando ser referência nacional no desenvolvimento industrial, no apoio ao associativismo e no atendimento eficiente.

Esta é a nossa missão: Promover, representar e defender a indústria paranaense, em busca da melhor competitividade e desenvolvimento sustentável.

Para você que deseja contribuir com o nosso propósito, de transformar o Paraná no melhor lugar para a indústria no Brasil, esta vaga pode ser sua!

Qual é a posição?

Vendedor I (Consultor de Vendas de Serviços) – RP 16875 Sistema Fiep (Fiep, Sesi, Senai e IEL)

Quais são os desafios e as principais responsabilidades?

  • Prospectar novas parcerias e potenciais clientes de negócios;
  • Contribuir para o aumento das vendas de todo o portfólio de produtos por meio da realização de visitas às empresas para a venda e fidelização de clientes;
  • Encaminhar as demandas de produtos/serviços, negociar preços, prazos e agenda junto aos técnicos e áreas responsáveis pelo atendimento aos clientes;
  • Monitorar a entrega dos produtos do IEL junto às indústrias por meio da aplicação e direcionamento da avaliação de eficácia dos serviços prestados;
  • Articular com a área técnica, realizando o gerenciamento da carteira de clientes, análises das regiões e cenários, monitoramento dos indicadores de desempenho;
  • Alimentar a base de dados com indicadores de negócio e de mercado identificando novos segmentos para atuação;
  • Avaliar o Pós-venda, analisar dados secundários, cadastro em sistema;
  • Realizar visitas periódicas aos clientes ativos e/ou potenciais, promovendo divulgação dos trabalhos, efetivando vendas, pesquisando grau de satisfação, necessidades, carências, e o que mais for pertinente para a organização, além de laborar relatórios de visitas;
  • Promover eventos culturais e de negócios, com o intuito de divulgar produtos os e serviços do Sistema Fiep, e estabelecer novos contatos e parcerias;
  • Identificar novos nichos de mercado e atuação do IEL, assessorando as diversas áreas de conhecimento e negócios no desenvolvimento de novos produtos, alinhados às carências e tendências de mercado;
  • Alimentar a base de dados com indicadores de negócio e de mercado;
  • Realizar gestão do CRM PJ;
  • Manter contato com empresas do segmento de serviços em treinamento e assessoria empresarial, buscando parcerias no agenciamento de serviços Sistema Fiep;
  • Executar atividades correlatas.

Requisitos

Gostou? Então verifique se você possui os requisitos abaixo:

  • Ensino Superior completo. Desejável em Administração, Marketing, Gestão de Vendas, Gestão comercial, entre outras;
  • Experiência em vendas B2B;
  • Experiência prévia com vendas de serviços e/ou produtos;
  • Experiência com o CRM e indicadores de vendas (BI);
  • Conhecimento em funil de vendas;
  • Desejável Pacote Office intermediário (principalmente Excel);
  • Possui CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Candidatos Internos, atender aos critérios de elegibilidade PL 0031 (4.2.3).

Fique por dentro de alguns detalhes sobre esta oportunidade:

Local de trabalho: Sesi – Irati (Endereço: Rua Coronel Emilio Gomes, 3 – Centro - Irati/PR)

Horário: Segunda a sexta das 08:00h às 12h00 e das 13h15 às 17h15 – 40 horas semanais

Em caso de reaproveitamento podemos considerar outros horários de atuação à critério de aceite do candidato aprovado.

Confira as etapas deste processo seletivo (todas eliminatórias):

Triagem RH - Solicitação documentos comprobatórios - Triagem do Gestor - Entrevista RH - Entrevista de Validação - Admissão.

Ficou interessado? Candidate-se e boa sorte!

O prazo para inscrição neste processo seletivo é do dia 27/06/2025 a 06/07/2025.

Essa vaga também se destina a pessoas com deficiência (PCD) ou reabilitados(as).

Este processo seletivo tem validade de 24 meses, podendo ocorrer o aproveitamento de candidatos aprovados em novas oportunidades deste mesmo perfil nas casas do Sistema Fiep (Fiep, Sesi, Senai e IEL) seguindo a ordem de classificação.

Escolaridade mínima: Ensino Superior - Concluído

title: Consultor(a) Comercial JR
description:
Job description

Dedicamo-nos a oferecer soluções de mobilidade que proporcionem experiências únicas por meio de nossos produtos e serviços. E isso só é possível porque temos uma equipe incrível , com brilho nos olhos e vontade de realizar!

É assim que fazemos acontecer! Inspirados pelo Poder dos Sonhos e movidos pelas crenças fundamentais da nossa Filosofia: #respeito ao indivíduo , #iniciativa , #igualdade e #confiança , temos contribuído para tornar a Honda uma empresa única, inovadora e desejada pela sociedade.

A Honda valoriza a Diversidade e Inclusão e tem um olhar que engloba o respeito e aceitação das pessoas por meio do reconhecimento das diferenças e da singularidade de cada um, podendo referir-se a gênero, raça, etnia, nacionalidade, idade, orientação sexual, deficiência, característica física, crença religiosa, perspectiva política, status social entre outros.

“Somos uma empresa focada no ser humano, movida pelo sonho de criar e pelo espírito dos desafios” Soichiro Honda

Se você se identifica conosco e deseja fazer parte deste time, vamos iniciar esta jornada!

Main responsibilities

Seu dia a dia transita por atividades multidisciplinares e desafios tais como:

  • Atendimento consultivo às concessionarias;
  • Responsável pelo resultado de vendas de motos e acessórios a nível Brasil;
  • Análise de indicadores e elaboração de planos de ação para atingimento de metas;
  • Elaboração de reports e apresentações para gerencia e diretoria.

Requirements and skills

O que buscamos em você:

  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes e/ou fornecedores, viagens comerciais e negociações comerciais;
  • Superior completo em Marketing, Administração, Engenharias, Economia e correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • CNH B;
  • Pacote Office intermediário.

O que será considerado um diferencial:

  • Cursos complementares: Atendimento a clientes, Técnicas de Negociação, Gestão de Negócios, Gestão Comercial;
  • Experiência em reporte e análise indicadores através de Power BI, Qlikview e/ou Tableau;
  • Experiência no setor automotivo.

Additional information

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Honda São Paulo (próximo ao shopping Morumbi). Vaga no modelo presencial de trabalho.

Informações adicionais:

Nos preocupamos com o seu bem-estar, por isso oferecemos os seguintes benefícios, os quais revalidaremos em sua jornada, pois variam de acordo com a localidade:

  • Nossa Jornada de Trabalho tem carga horária flexível e banco de horas para usufruir sempre que precisar;
  • Oferecemos Vale Refeição, Van Honda x Metrô, Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Vale Transporte, Auxilio Creche para as mamães, estacionamento, Wellhub e a PreviHonda;
  • Programas de desenvolvimento e conexão tais como Saúde e Bem-estar;
  • Descontos em nossos produtos Honda;
  • Bônus anual;

E um pouquinho a mais sobre nós:

Presente no Brasil desde 1971, a Moto Honda da Amazônia Ltda é atualmente a maior fabricante de motos do país, com mais de 27 milhões de unidades produzidas em Manaus (AM). Desde 2001, a empresa produz também motores estacionários e motobombas, além de comercializar a linha de motores e máquinas no país.

Em 1992, com a criação da Honda Automóveis do Brasil Ltda. , a empresa entrou no mercado automotivo brasileiro.

Faz parte do grupo também a Honda Serviços Financeiros , que reúne o Consórcio Nacional Honda , a corretora de Seguro Honda e o Banco Honda que facilitam o acesso dos clientes aos produtos da marca.

Durante esses anos a empresa também inaugurou Centros Educacionais de Trânsito, de Treinamento Técnico, de Distribuição de Peças e de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento, além do seu próprio parque eólico no sul do país.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Strategic Account Executive role at Canonical

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

  • Acompanhamento diário dos indicadores da área e qualidade dos estoques, assim como das condições de armazenagem dos produtos nos armazéns;
  • Amostrar os fertilizantes, para posterior análise granulométrica e química, quando necessário;
  • Validação dos COAs de importação;
  • Validação dos materiais indiretos utilizados na produção, como por exemplo, qualidade e especificações dos big bags.
  • Presença a campo e ministrar treinamentos para o suporte da equipe comercial/ fornecedores/parceiros;
  • Acompanhamento das atividades referentes às licenças de operação junto ao MAPA.
Qualificações

description:
A career in IBM Software means you'll be part of a team that transforms our customer's challenges into industry-leading solutions. We are an infinitely curious team, always seeking new possibilities, and dedicated to creating the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native software solutions. Our renowned legacy creates endless global opportunities for our network of IBMers. We are a team of deep product experts, ensuring exceptional client experiences, with a focus on delivery, excellence, and obsession over customer outcomes. This position involves contributing to HashiCorp's offerings, now part of IBM, which empower organizations to automate and secure multi-cloud and hybrid environments. You will join a team managing the lifecycle of infrastructure and security, enhancing IBM's cloud solutions to ensure enterprises achieve efficiency, security, and scalability in their cloud journey.

Your role and responsibilities

Customer Success Engineers (CSEs) at HashiCorp act as our customers’ primary technical point of contact, serving as experts to help drive product adoption, establish best practices and increase value attainment across our customers’ journey! CSEs help our customers successfully onboard and integrate their HashiCorp tools into their software stacks and development lifecycles. CSEs also help customers recognize maximum value with our tooling by focusing on driving adoption of additional high-value product use cases. Finally, CSEs ensure customers are prepared for an on-time renewal by cementing the value of the HashiCorp toolchain within their stack, and by mitigating any risks to the renewal.

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

As a Senior Manager, Customer Success Engineer at HashiCorp, you will lead a diverse team in a high-performance environment, applying your expertise in technical account management! Your role will be pivotal in guiding our CoE Customer Success Engineer to be responsible for the customer lifecycle: driving our customers to successful renewals, improving their happiness with HashiCorp, and growing adoption of our products across their journey. You will be reporting to the AMER Theater Leader for Customer Lifecycle Management.

● Lead all aspects of a team of CSEs, providing leadership, mentorship, and direction

● Lead team performance, set clear goals, and foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement

● Understand the HashiCorp customer journey and lead the continued execution and development of our customer-facing motions with the goal of driving customer satisfaction, consumption of license and acquiring outstanding renewal rates

● Build and maintain positive relationships with key customer partners, account team leadership, and internal collaborators and leaders, managing risks and opportunities related to product adoption, renewal, and expansion

● Work closely with the Value Engineering and Product Management teams to translate customer needs into technical solutions and contribute to new product requirements

● Drive strategic opportunities across the entire customer journey

● Comfort working on hybrid more (2 days remote and 3 days at the office per week)

Required education

Bachelor's Degree

Preferred education

None

Required technical and professional expertise

● Strong management experience in technical account management, solution architecture, sales engineering, or related fields.

● Strong running AMER accounts and deep knowledge of the AMER market.

● Strong business management fundamentals and experience in a Professional Services or Software Startup company.

● Good demonstrated leadership in running technical teams with a focus on getting results and team development.

● People leadership and a recognized leader in the organizations where you previously worked.

● Demonstrated experience leading strategic customer accounts and large projects.

● Deep knowledge in cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and HashiCorp products.

● Outstanding communication skills with the ability to lead stakeholder relationships effectively.

● Certifications in HashiCorp Secure Products, Cloud providers (AWS/Azure/GCP), and container orchestration (CKA) are highly desirable.

● B.S. degree in an engineering or similar program from an accredited college/university (or equivalent experience) preferred.

● 50% travel required (within Latam and US).

● Experience in Latam (mainly Brazil) and portuguese language.

Preferred technical and professional experience

Familiarity with HashiCorp and IBM technologies and services.

ABOUT BUSINESS UNIT

IBM Software infuses core business operations with intelligence—from machine learning to generative AI—to help make organizations more responsive, productive, and resilient. IBM Software helps clients put AI into action now to create real value with trust, speed, and confidence across digital labor, IT automation, application modernization, security, and sustainability. In most organizations data is spread across multiple clouds, on premises, in private datacenters, and at the edge. title: Especialista de Torre de Controle, First Mile
description:
The First Mile team is looking for an SPC Shift Manager to join our Seller Processing Center in Osasco, SP.
Are you ready to work hard, have fun and make history? If so, Amazon may be the right place for you. Our logistics teams are redefining the way we serve customers across the globe, solving some of the most complex challenges in the industry.
Amazon’s transportation network ensures packages are delivered efficiently and reliably, whether the items are large or small. As an SPC Shift Manager, you will be responsible for leading operations within a Seller Processing Center. You will manage Team Leads, Operators and Delivery Service Providers, as well as oversee the performance and relationships with external staffing partners.
This role requires flexibility, leadership and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, startup-like environment. We value bold ideas, test and learn approaches, and continuous improvement.
If you are customer-obsessed, thrive in dynamic environments and have experience in high-performance operations, we want to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
- Being based at one of our Seller Processing Centers (SPCs), working day and night shifts. Amazon operates 24/7, so this role includes shift work, which may involve weekends and holidays.
- Overseeing operations focused on the pickup of Amazon orders from sellers and ensuring they are sent to last mile stations for customer delivery.
- Supporting a team of operational leaders in the daily management of the SPC, including labor allocation, leading shift meetings, assigning tasks, and coordinating with internal and external partners.
- Managing key performance indicators (KPIs) such as On-Time Dispatch and First Day Pickup Success, while continuously improving the customer experience.
- Applying strong analytical and project management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to influence stakeholders.
- Being metrics-driven, investigating root causes quickly and using data to drive process improvements.
- Solving complex problems with practical, scalable solutions—without compromising quality or core functionality.
- Using excellent problem-solving and communication skills to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Supporting the implementation of new systems and processes, providing hands-on support and collecting feedback for improvements.
- Mapping business requirements, analyzing workflows, and designing operational solutions.
- Leveraging software and hardware tools to ensure seamless daily operations, while ensuring associates have the necessary tools and coordinating repairs or replacements as needed.
- Reporting daily metrics and operational exceptions to internal teams and relevant departments across Amazon.
- Maintaining flexibility to work a variety of schedules based on business needs, including overnight shifts, weekends, and holidays.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Employee and performance management experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience.

Seria ótimo se você também tivesse:

  • Experiência em promover e implementar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro em toda a organização;

Company Financials Market Senior Data Analyst

Business Area

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes.

The Company Financials team provides our clients with fast and accurate market-moving data so they can stay on top of their game: broker estimates, financial filings, and any other dataset that is useful to understand financial performance in the markets. Our products run on intelligence and industry-specific insights provided by the industry teams. We combine financial modeling, industry expertise, data management, and technical skills to curate critical metrics and drive insights from our data.

We are dedicated to crafting a best-in-class financial analysis and modeling product while constantly looking to enhance and expand our existing offering through a deep understanding of the markets we operate in, the sectors we cover, and our clients current and future needs.

What’s the role?

The Company Financials Market Data team is looking for a Senior Market Data Analyst who combines strong relationship management, market insight, and regulatory awareness to lead product development to incorporate regional nuances and relevance to the respective markets. This role focuses on understanding financial market structure, maintaining strong partnerships, and ensuring data quality and timeliness to support our suite of Company Financials products. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and other Company Financials teams, helping shape the direction of our data offerings in response to client demand and market developments.

We’ll trust you to:

  • Monitor and interpret financial regulations, exchange rule changes, and emerging trends to ensure Bloomberg’s Company Financials data offering remains compliant, competitive, and market-leading.
  • Maintain and grow relationships with exchanges and third-party data vendors across multiple geographies to secure access to critical data sources and insights.
  • Lead initiatives to improve and expand market data coverage, helping design and manage structured projects aligned with business and client needs.
  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders (Engineering, Product, Financial Product, Compliance) to translate market needs into actionable data strategies.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on specific markets or data types, guiding how financial filings and disclosures are sourced, processed, interpreted, and used across Bloomberg platforms.
  • Contribute to the development of automation and monitoring tools by offering business insight and data structure understanding; some familiarity with Python or scripting is welcome.
  • Create and maintain clear documentation, business rules, and operating procedures to support team scalability and transparency.
  • Represent the Company Financials team in external engagements such as working groups, regulatory consultations, and client feedback sessions.
You’ll need to have:
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in financial markets, particularly within market data, exchanges, investor relations, or regulatory environments.
  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Deep understanding of company filings, financial disclosures, and market data structures.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive results across teams.
  • Proven track record of external stakeholder management and relationship building.
  • A proactive mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with an ability to distill complex issues for a variety of audiences.
We’d love to see:
  • Familiarity with the Bloomberg Terminal, Company Financials products, and/or Bloomberg’s data management workflows.
  • Experience working with or within financial exchanges or regulators.
  • Knowledge of key global financial reporting regimes (e.g. IFRS, US GAAP).
  • Exposure to data science or coding tools (e.g., Python, SQL) to support data exploration and project work.
  • Multilingual skills or experience working in a global context.
