title: Shop Foreman
description:
Position Responsibilities:

  1. Directs the maintenance and repair of Antarctic equipment.

  2. Functions as recognized technical expert in the field of Antarctic equipment maintenance and repair.

  3. Performs extremely complex repairs on a broad range of equipment in the shop and in the field.

  4. Responsible for corrective maintenance accomplishment as outlined by program management.

  5. Directs the work of all skilled workers, administrators and helpers engaged in the repair and upkeep of assigned mobile and stationary equipment, associated tooling and materials, and supporting parts stock.

  6. Ensures work request priorities are completed and adjusts tasking as mission requires in order to meet urgent needs.

  7. Coordinates work requirements and assigns personnel to specific tasks.

  8. Executes and/or monitors all in-progress work to ensure quality, timely completion and control of material.

  9. Delegates assigned tasks and performs inspections of all work in progress on a daily basis.

  10. Documents work order progress and communicates issues that arise with customers and management.

  11. Maintains records of shop activities, on both individual work orders and permanent technical documentation.

  12. Prepares and submits reports on the progress of all new work projects, and individuals assigned.

  13. Generates requisitions for supplies. Provides assessments of and recommendations for equipment.

  14. Supports achievement of ASC metrics, whether metrics can be directly or indirectly affected by this position’s activities.

  15. Complies with ASC Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements and goals, and ensures that subordinate employees do the same.

  16. Maintains and provides documentation to others as necessary to ensure adequate legal documentation.

  17. Handles confidential matters (personnel actions, management reports, etc.) in accordance with management policy.

  18. Responsible for the training and development of the crew assigned, to include a healthy safety culture and an environment of technical competence and professional execution of a world-class maintenance program.

  19. Responsible for the safety and accountability of the crew assigned, to include maintaining a safe workplace program and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.

  20. Performs other duties as required.

SPoT Only:

  1. Operates heavy equipment for assigned traverse for no less than a 50-day duration to the South Pole and back at least once max twice.

  2. Live and work in close quarters with up to 10 people for the duration of the traverse.

Field Camps Only:

  1. Diagnoses troubleshoots, repairs, and maintains construction, agriculture and heavy support equipment.

  2. Diagnoses troubleshoots, repairs, and maintains small engines and diesel fired heaters.

  3. Performs service, maintenance, repairs and overhauls in accordance with manufacturers’ recommendations.

  4. Analyzes and diagnoses mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, electric, and electronic faults.

  5. Live and work in close quarters for the duration of the field season in a remote camp setting.

  6. Operates heavy equipment for assigned traverse or camp.

  7. Lifts, moves and/or installs heavy parts and assemblies safely, using basic tooling and PPE. May perform work outside in severe weather conditions.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.

  2. Minimum of ten years of experience in machinery trades, including small engine, automotive or heavy equipment maintenance and repair, or relevant mechanical experience is required.

  3. Two of the ten years’ experience must be in a supervisory or leadership position.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Knowledge of sound mechanical practices as applied to commercial and special purpose equipment, using chemicals and tools, methods of handling heavy mechanisms, internal combustion engines and electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems.

  2. Team player and group dynamics are of the utmost importance.

Preferred:

  1. Two years training at a technical school is preferred.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.

  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.

  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.

  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.

  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.

  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.

  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Se identificou com a nossa cultura? Então embarque nesse foguete!

>> Sobre a vaga

Essa oportunidade é para atuar na área de QuantDevs, que tem a missão de construir sistemas-chave relacionados a finanças quantitativas para as linhas de negócio de investimentos da XP. Esse é um time que desenvolve software para atender as demandas dinâmicas de áreas de Front Office e orientar a tomada de decisões financeiras.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Construção de sistemas de risco, posição e dados de mercado para as áreas de trading do banco;
  • Tomada de decisões que requerem aplicar conhecimento específico de negócio a tradeoffs nos sistemas desenvolvidos;
  • Fazer interlocução com stakeholders relevantes (áreas Global Markets, Tesouraria e Risco de Mercado) para entender necessidades;
  • Montar ferramentas para validação de resultados dos sistemas em construção;
  • Conhecimento de programação em linguagens de back-end (Go, C++, Python, C#, Java, etc);
  • Conhecimento de probabilidade, estatística e cálculo;
  • Familiaridade com produtos financeiros.

>> Você pode ter destaques:

  • Já tiver atuado em áreas de desenvolvimento quantitativo em outras instituições financeiras;
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido de finanças quantitativas ou engenharia financeira;
  • Ter a capacidade de construir sistemas financeiros com qualidade e velocidade em ambientes de muita autonomia.

>> Benefícios para você:

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. title: YouTube Strategist
description:
Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a YouTube Strategist!

Note to Applicants:

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About the Role

We are looking for a strategic and data-driven YouTube Strategist to help us grow our YouTube presence and reach the right audience with compelling, high-performing content. In this role, you will work closely with content creators, video editors, and the marketing team to define and implement a growth strategy that aligns with our brand goals.

Responsibilities

  • Audit and analyze current YouTube channel performance, content, and audience behavior.
  • Develop and execute data-informed strategies to grow subscribers, views, and watch time.
  • Plan and manage the content calendar in alignment with audience insights and business goals.
  • Optimize titles, thumbnails, descriptions, tags, and playlists for SEO and click-through.
  • Stay up to date with platform trends, algorithm updates, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with video editors and creative teams to ensure content quality and consistency.
  • Track and report on KPIs, providing actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Identify growth opportunities such as collaborations, shorts, or paid campaigns.
  • Support monetization efforts through audience growth and strategic content planning.

Requirements

  • Proven experience growing YouTube channels (personal or professional).
  • Strong understanding of YouTube SEO, algorithm, and analytics.
  • Ability to translate data into content and strategy decisions.
  • Familiarity with tools like TubeBuddy, VidIQ, YouTube Studio, and Google Analytics.
  • Creative mindset with a passion for storytelling and digital video trends.
  • Excellent communication and project management skills.
  • Experience in content marketing, digital media, or social media strategy is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with influencers or content creators.
  • Basic video editing or scripting skills.
  • Knowledge of paid media (YouTube Ads).
  • Multilingual or experience with global audiences.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development

Então junte-se à Tractebel, parte do Grupo ENGIE, e aos nossos 5600 especialistas apaixonados em todo o mundo, motivados por moldar um mundo mais sustentável todos os dias. É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da aventura do século: acelerar a transição energética - ao mesmo tempo que melhora a vida das pessoas, através de projetos com significado. Dê a sua contribuição para neutralizar o carbono em mercados como de nuclear, energia, infraestrutura, saneamento e meio ambiente.
Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!
O que oferecemos

  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global . É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo. A empresa apoia ativamente o desenvolvimento dos seus empregados e as oportunidades de crescimento são muito amplas.
  • Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios atrativo que inclui plano de saúde e odontológico, vale-refeição e alimentação, previdência privada, seguro de vida, wellhub, programa de incentivo de idioma e pós-graduação, além de opções de compra de ações da ENGIE.
  • Sabemos que o equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional é fundamental para seu bem-estar. Por isso, você pode trabalhar de casa até 1 dia por semana e pode iniciar suas atividades entre 7h30 e 9h30 e encerrar entre 16h30 e 18h30, respectivamente.
  • Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão . Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação.
  • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.
A sua missão
Como Analista de Controle e Automação da área de Energia, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias.
As suas principais responsabilidades
  • Dar suporte a sistemas de automação e controle, incluindo redes industriais, CLPs, sistemas supervisórios e softwares de aquisição e tratamento de dados operacionais.
  • Apoio na especificação de sistemas de automação e instrumentação para processos industriais.
  • Diagnosticar falhas e otimizar processos em sistemas de automação e instrumentação industrial.
  • Suporte à integração de novas tecnologias, digitalização e cibersegurança e projetos de melhorias em malhas de controle.
  • Apoiar o time operacional nas demandas de comunicação entre sistemas de controle e equipamentos de campo.
  • Liderar análises de falhas, propor planos de ação para correção e prevenção de recorrência de falhas.
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos operacionais e de manutenção, assegurando a padronização, segurança e eficiência dos processos, com base em normas técnicas e melhores práticas do setor de energia.
  • Garantir a conformidade com normas técnicas nacionais e internacionais (ABNT, NR’s, ISA, IEC, API, ASME etc.).
Gostaríamos de ser contactados por pessoas com
  • Graduação em Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Elétrica ou Eletrônica;
  • Experiência prévia no setor de óleo e gás;
Quem somos
As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

description:
Welcome to KTO Group, where innovation drives excitement in iGaming. Founded in 2018 by Andreas Bardun, we’re transforming online gaming with a focus on transparency and player satisfaction.

At KTO.com , we blend the thrill of sports betting with online casino entertainment, tailored to local markets and powered by our proprietary platform for a seamless, personalized experience.

KTO is a rising leader in LATAM, proudly ranked among Brazil’s top 10 iGaming brands. Join us as we set new standards in trust, innovation, and the future of iGaming.

The Data Protection Officer (DPO) is responsible for ensuring the organization’s compliance with data protection laws and internal data governance frameworks. This includes building and maintaining a robust data protection strategy, managing data risks, and promoting a privacy- centric culture. In addition to traditional DPO duties, the role also extends to supporting intellectual property (IP) protection, including trademark portfolio management and enforcement through cease-and-desist letters.


Key Responsibilities
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all matters related to data privacy and protection.
  • Monitor compliance with the LGPD, GDPR, and other applicable data protection laws.
  • Advise on and implement privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default principles.
  • Develop, review, and maintain internal data protection and privacy policies and procedures.
  • Review and draft DPA.
  • Oversee the enterprise Data Protection Risk Management System.
  • Conduct and document Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for new projects, tools, or services.
  • Maintain and update the data protection risk register and coordinate mitigations.
  • Collaborate with IT and security teams on incident response planning and breach notification processes.
  • Lead data mapping efforts across the organization to ensure up-to-date records of processing activities.
  • Identify and classify personal data across business units and third-party vendors.
  • Maintain and ensure the accuracy of the organization’s RoPA documentation.
  • Develop and operate workflows to efficiently respond to data subject access requests, deletion requests, and other rights.
  • Ensure timely, lawful, and accurate responses to DSRs in accordance with regulatory timelines.
  • Draft, implement, and update privacy and security policies including:
  • Data Retention Policies
  • Information Security Policies
  • Vendor Privacy Standards
  • Design and deliver employee awareness programs and mandatory data protection training sessions.
  • Manage the organization’s trademark and copyright portfolio including registration, renewals, and monitoring.
  • Monitor for potential infringements or unauthorized use of IP and coordinate enforcement.
  • Draft, send, and follow up on cease-and-desist letters related to IP violations.
  • Coordinate IP strategy
  • Coordinate with outside counsel for IP litigation and formal disputes when required.
  • Work cross-functionally with Legal, IT, Marketing, HR, and Product teams to align data protection practices.
  • Liaise with regulators, including Data Protection Authorities (DPAs), on audits, complaints, or breaches.
  • Support contract reviews from a privacy and IP compliance standpoint (e.g., DPAs, SCCs, IP clauses).
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law,
  • Certification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or equivalent preferred.
  • Minimum 3-5 years experience in data protection, privacy law and Intellectul Property.
  • Experience with LGPD,GDPR, and international data protection standards.
  • Familiarity with IP law, trademark processes, and enforcement mechanisms.
Skills
  • Strong understanding of data privacy laws and regulatory frameworks.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and analytical abilities.
  • Familiarity with legal writing, especially in cease-and-desist and regulatory contexts.
  • Proficiency with privacy tech tools, data mapping platforms, and risk registers.

title: Pipefitter - Facilities
description:
Summary:

Seasonal Contract position supporting the National Science Foundation managed United States Antarctic Program as part of the Antarctic Support Contract (ASC). Pipefitter will perform maintenance or construction welding tasking, or any combination thereof, under the supervision of the Plumbing Foreman. Tasking is based on employee’s prior work experience and ASC schedule requirements.

Position Responsibilities (not all inclusive):

  1. Perform pipe welding and structural welding tasks on maintenance and construction projects.
  2. Perform cutting, fitting/welding, connection, and installation of piping.
  3. Weld various types and sizes of piping, using multi-process techniques.
  4. Timely response to emergency service calls during and outside of normal working hours.
  5. Accurate and thorough documentation of hours worked, tasking performed, materials used, and processes involved.
  6. Advise immediate Supervisor of job progress and material/labor requirements.
  7. Accomplish tasking working from Job Plans, verbal information, schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, documents, vendor/manufacturer manuals, and applicable specifications and codes.
  8. Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), suggest revisions as needed, and create SOPs as directed.
  9. Perform tasking outdoors in environmentally challenging conditions including wind and extreme cold weather.
  10. Use solid decision-making ability and sound judgment to safely and effectively solve problems.
  11. Proactively identify any unsafe conditions or hazards and communicate them effectively.
  12. Work directly with other departments to plan and complete tasking.
  13. Learn and use computer-based labor, material, and maintenance tracking applications.
  14. May deploy to remote research support facilities for day trips or extended periods (McMurdo only).
  15. Occasionally utilize the assistance of other station personnel to complete tasking, or assist other trades or departments with their tasking.
  16. Comply with all ASC Environmental, Safety and Health (ESH), Waste Management and Quality Assurance requirements.
  17. Participate in Work Center Safety Program and ASC safety objectives.
  18. Participate in community programs such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (station clean-up), “GASH” (galley clean-up at Palmer), and recycling efforts.
  19. Perform other duties as required.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED.
  2. Previous 6G welding certification at time of hire.
  3. Must pass a 6G welding certification exam prior to deployment.
  4. Minimum 4 years’ experience in pipe fitting and pipe welding work.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Ability to read and interpret design drawings, specifications, and diagrams.
  2. Experience in construction and/or maintenance of commercial and/or industrial facilities.
  3. Possess prior computer experience and be able and willing to learn and effectively utilize computer-based labor, inventory, and maintenance tracking applications.
  4. Possess the competencies, willingness and ability to perform the duties of position.

Preferred:

  1. Experience working with a variety of pipe materials.
  2. Brazing experience.
  3. Rigging experience.
  4. Prior cold weather welding experience.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.
  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.
  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.
  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.
  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.
  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.
  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.

description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing organization. The right person will help move our machine learning capabilities to the next level. You’ll be working in an organization where AI is the enabler and center of its core business strategy. You want to be part of a small, intensely skilled team, who feel total ownership of their work, and can’t imagine a day without learning & coding. You will play a crucial role in the Xometry platform and everything you do will matter.

What You’ll Do:

  • At Xometry, you will play a crucial role in exploring new machine learning opportunities, researching and performing proof of concepts, and bringing new machine learning and AI solutions into Xometry’s platform.
  • Develop and implement machine learning models that improve Xometry’s ability to predict cost, price, and sourcing options for our customers and suppliers.
  • You will be responsible for leading the evaluation of emerging technologies, identifying areas for improvement, and developing new features while ensuring the reliability and scalability of Xometry’s platform.
  • Lead the exploration of emerging AI and machine learning technologies and develop proof-of-concepts to assess their potential impact on Xometry’s platform.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, prioritize features, and define technical solutions based on the latest innovations.
  • Monitor machine learning models and AI performance and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
  • Contribute to the documentation and knowledge base to help other teams understand and use Xometry’s AI effectively.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience with state of the art ML modeling techniques and approaches like transformers, self-supervised pre-training, generative modeling, LLMs, etc.
  • Experience with large scale data processing (e.g., hands-on experience training and applying models at scale using deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Successful candidates in this role need to be able to bridge state of the art approaches to real world impact.
  • A cloud-native software craftsperson with hands-on experience with containers, container orchestration, and distributed systems.
  • An engineer with a self-driven attitude who can own problems and deliver solutions.
  • Strong software fundamentals with experience in design patterns, refactoring, OOP, and testing.
  • A cloud practitioner who values the “shift-left” mentality by building systems with Infrastructure as Code, not console clicking.
  • Data’s at the heart of our systems, we hope it's yours too. You’re comfortable working with SQL and/or NoSQL, understand database design, and data analysis.
  • Experience building and consuming CI/CD pipelines.
  • Someone who knows their way around the command line and has experience working with *nix systems.
  • 5+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products.
  • 3+ years experience leading cross-team engineering efforts.
  • Strong execution skills in project management.

Here at Xometry we believe in diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging. We are committed to welcoming, respecting, and valuing people for who they are as individuals, learning from their differences, embracing their uniqueness, and providing a positive workplace for all.

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Seu bem-estar importa. Junte-se a uma empresa que se importa também.

*Grande novidade: Gympass agora é Wellhub!

Estamos felizes em anunciar nossa mudança de marca para Wellhub, um marco significativo na nossa jornada. Essa transformação reflete nossa evolução de “passe para academias” para uma solução ampla de bem-estar para colaboradores. alcançar o seu máximo potencial. Para alcançar a nossa missão, é essencial garantir que todas as pessoas no Wellhub se sintam acolhidas, valorizadas e empoderadas

Estamos contratando uma Diretora Senior de Venda de Clientes Regionais para nosso time de Vendas em São Paulo, Brasil !

A Wellhub possui uma marca sólida como benefício de atividade física no Brasil e, nos últimos dois anos, expandiu sua solução para bem-estar. Atualmente, a Wellhub é uma plataforma de bem-estar corporativo que ajuda empresas a gerenciar e comunicar seus programas de bem-estar aos colaboradores, com acesso a academias, personal trainers, nutrição, saúde emocional e terapia online.

Considerando essa expansão, estamos em busca de uma Diretora de Vendas que possa liderar esse momento estratégico da nossa empresa. Traga o bem-estar para o centro do trabalho e crie um ambiente de apoio onde todos se sintam confortáveis cuidando de si mesmos, tirando folgas e encontrando o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Uma profissional de vendas com experiência relevante em contextos de rápido crescimento e transformação organizacional

  • Conhecimento e vivência com ciclos de vendas para grandes contas no Brasil

The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region.   • Interact closely with the Americas HR Manager and the Global Head of HR to create impact across all HR regions

  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights

  • Experience mentoring and developing others

  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)

  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Somos a Alice, o primeiro plano de saúde do Brasil com time de saúde.
Acreditamos em um modelo de saúde inovador e colocamos o nosso membro no centro das decisões por meio da tecnologia, empatia, transparência e simplicidade.
A nossa missão é tornar o mundo mais saudável e este não é um desafio fácil. Revolucionar a saúde no Brasil requer resiliência, energia e inovação.
Por causa da nossa tecnologia própria, somos capazes de integrar nossos parceiros e garantir que nosso Time de Saúde acompanhe cada membro de perto.
Conectamos, de maneira simples e estruturada, toda a jornada de saúde dos membros da Alice (histórico de saúde, agendamentos, exames etc), o que nos permite fazer uma gestão da saúde completa e precisa de cada pessoa.

Local da prestação de serviços
Serão diferentes oportunidades em São Paulo, cada uma atuando em diferentes locais:

A atuação médica será realizada no seu próprio consultório e ele deverá estar localizado em um destes locais.

Sobre a parceria:
Como geneticista parceiro(a) que presta serviço na Alice, você será responsável por realizar consultas dos membros encaminhados pela atenção primária para sua especialidade.

Requisitos para a parceira:

  • Médico(a) com residência concluída e/ou título em Genética
  • Ter disponibilidade de agenda em até 7 dias úteis
  • Ter disponibilidade para consultas presenciais e online
  • Utilizar a tecnologia Alice tanto para assuntos administrativos (exemplo: elegibilidade), quanto assistenciais (ex: prontuário)
  • Ter as lógicas de cuidado e protocolos Alice como um norte para o cuidado dos nossos membros
  • Atuação SEMPRE baseada em evidência científica, buscando chegar nos desfechos da forma mais custo efetiva
  • Abertura para atuar em conjunto com a atenção primária da Alice e demais especialistas no cuidado do membro
  • Interesse por estar sempre se desenvolvendo e atualizando seu conhecimento técnico

Somos uma Healthtech fundada em 2019 com o propósito de tornar o mundo mais saudável; o que isso quer dizer, na prática, é que estamos trabalhando duro todos os dias para construir o que um sistema de saúde eficiente e humano deveriam ser.

Não é sobre usar tecnologia para um problema irrelevante ou pequeno, mas sim, repensar como a tecnologia deveria ser usada para gerar mais saúde e mais cuidado para as pessoas

Saúde está entre os maiores desafios da nossa geração: experiência subótima, baixos resultados na geração de saúde e custo exponencialmente crescente.

Alice é um novo capítulo em planos de saúde, implementando uma abordagem de cuidado coordenado e continuado, através de metodologias e tecnologias próprias, pensadas com o Membro no centro das decisões.

Para isso, buscamos um profissional que nos ajude, cada vez mais, a transformar vidas.

title: After Sales Coordinator
description:
DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

We are a fast-paced team focused on making every partner feel supported, guided, and empowered from day one. This role is critical to ensure that our partners have a positive experience during their first steps with us and continue to see value through meaningful touchpoints, support on improving their pages, and increased visibility and orders on the platform.

You’ll be part of a cross-functional and data-driven team that believes in building strong foundations and long-term relationships with our partners through structured onboarding, scalable processes, and high-quality interactions.

In this role, you'll be...

  • A team leader, guiding and developing a group of After Sales Analysts with clear goals and structured feedback
  • The owner of your vertical’s performance and strategic KPIs, including activation rate, orders tracking, page quality, and partner satisfaction
  • An analytical thinker who challenges the status quo and continuously improves internal processes and partner experience
  • Obsessed with customer outcomes and feedback, always looking for ways to turn insights into action
  • A builder of scalable, repeatable, and measurable solutions that can be deployed across markets
  • Responsible for managing performance, productivity and SLA of onboarding activities and quality items
  • Accountable for implementing playbooks, improving partner surveys, and ensuring full data and content accuracy on our platform

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Outstanding team leadership and people management skills, with experience in coaching, performance review, and career development
  • Strong adaptability in high-growth and ever-changing environments
  • High level of ownership and resilience when dealing with operational challenges and ambiguous situations
  • Excellent communication skills and a customer-first mindset
  • Solid analytical skills with experience using data to drive insights and decision-making
  • At least 3+ years of experience in a coordination/leadership role in After Sales, Customer Success or Account Management
  • A proven track record in managing KPIs and delivering measurable impact
  • h.Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce, Hubspot, Zendesk) and automation platforms
  • Strong collaboration skills and a proactive attitude when engaging with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese and intermediate to advanced English
  • Experience working in tech companies, marketplaces or B2B2C environments

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value
We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven
We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration
Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity
Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth
We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion
Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

title: Data Management Operations Specialist
description:
Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive

Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Data Management Operations Specialist to join our Data Management team in the insurance industry. This individual will play a critical role in supporting the Data Management Strategy and Operations Leader by overseeing the daily operations of our data management processes, ensuring the accuracy, accessibility, and compliance of data, and implementing strategic initiatives aimed at optimizing data governance and quality. This is a unique opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and contribute to the evolution of data management within a fast-paced and highly regulated industry.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Support Data Operations: Assist in managing the end-to-end data lifecycle, from data acquisition and processing to storage, usage, and retirement. Ensure consistent, high-quality data availability across business units.
  • Data Governance and Compliance: Collaborate with the Data Governance team to ensure that data practices are in line with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, and industry-specific standards) and organizational policies.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Monitor and maintain data integrity and consistency across various systems. Identify and address data quality issues, collaborating with technical teams for remediation.
  • Data Reporting & Analytics: Support the generation of data reports for both operational and strategic decision-making. Analyze data trends and patterns to provide actionable insights.
  • Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate data management workflows and recommend improvements to streamline processes, enhance data accessibility, and reduce manual effort.
  • Collaboration: Act as a liaison between technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership to ensure alignment on data management objectives, projects, and outcomes.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain comprehensive documentation for data management processes, workflows, and policies. Provide training and support to staff on best practices related to data usage and governance.
  • Technology Integration: Assist in the integration of new data management tools and technologies to improve operational efficiency and data governance standards.
Functional Skills:
  • Data Management & Governance: Strong understanding of data management principles, including data classification, data lineage, data security, and data privacy, with the ability to apply them in a regulated industry.
  • Business Process Management: Knowledge of insurance industry operations, with the ability to translate business requirements into actionable data management strategies and improvements.
  • Compliance & Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with industry regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, and Solvency II, ensuring data management practices are compliant with legal standards.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Effective communication skills to collaborate across departments and manage expectations, ensuring alignment on data-related objectives.
  • Problem-Solving & Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify inefficiencies or risks in data management processes and develop solutions to mitigate them.
Technical Skills:
  • Data Management Tools: Proficiency in data management platforms (e.g., Informatica, Talend, Collibra, Alteryx) and business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Qlik).
  • Database Knowledge: Familiarity with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, DB2) and big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) to assist in data operations and troubleshooting.
  • Data Modeling & ETL: Experience with data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing techniques to ensure accurate and efficient data integration.
  • Data Quality Tools: Experience with data profiling, data quality assessment, and monitoring tools to ensure data is fit for use.
  • Scripting & Automation: Basic knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, SQL) to automate data processing and ensure consistency across platforms.
  • Cloud Technologies: Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and services for data storage and processing.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in data management, preferably within the insurance or financial services sector.
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams and a fast-paced environment.
  • Certifications in data management, such as DAMA (Data Management Association), are a plus.
  • Knowledge of insurance-specific data structures (e.g., policy, claims, underwriting data) is an advantage.
Desired Attributes:
  • Highly organized with a keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach to problem-solving.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset to anticipate challenges and opportunities in data management.
Why Join Us?
This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking data management team that drives operational excellence within the insurance industry. You will have the chance to work alongside a talented group of professionals and contribute to the future of data management, while making a direct impact on the company's data-driven initiatives.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and be a key player in a dynamic, data-focused environment, we encourage you to apply

  • Organização e proatividade.

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Desde dezembro de 2024, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

O Hospital Cardoso Fontes é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia .

Formação de acordo com a função exercida;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área de atuação.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo suas áreas de atuação com projetos em desenvolvimento na área de Assistência Social e Educação. Essa gama de atividades consolida a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, buscando sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados e com notável expertise.

Assim, a SPDM contribui efetivamente para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando garantir a universalidade e oportunidades de acesso à saúde, essenciais ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para isso, combina tecnologia de ponta com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 no município de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados. Desde então, busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde oferecidos aos usuários do SUS.

O programa tem como objetivo promover mudanças nos indicadores de saúde e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo dos serviços.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Periodicamente, publica anúncios recrutando esses profissionais nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios onde estão suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, beneficiando a população de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica, compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis de assistência, garantindo atendimento de qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Missão do Cargo

Atuar como Cientista de Dados em um ambiente em transformação, com foco inicial no desenvolvimento de um projeto estratégico de People Analytics . O profissional será responsável por aplicar modelagens descritivas e preditivas, atuar com soluções em nuvem (AWS/Sagemaker) e absorver entregas envolvendo modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , garantindo sustentação e evolução contínua.

  • Sustentar e evoluir entregas já em produção com LLMs , especialmente via AWS Bedrock .
  • Apoiar na transição do time atual de BI para uma nova arquitetura orientada à Ciência de Dados.
  • Atuar diretamente no projeto de People Analytics , mas com possibilidade de envolvimento em iniciativas futuras nas áreas de logística e indústria.
  • Participar ativamente de um ambiente que está sendo reposicionado pela diretoria como data-driven e orientado à inovação.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com Python ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.

  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (AWS) , incluindo Sagemaker .
  • Conhecimento prático em LLMs (Large Language Models) e atuação com projetos em AWS Bedrock .
  • Desejável experiência anterior em projetos de People Analytics .

Competências Comportamentais

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação para atuação próxima a áreas de negócio.
  • Perfil analítico e solucionador de problemas , com foco em resultado.
  • Adaptabilidade a cenários desafiadores, com criatividade para atuar mesmo com recursos limitados.

Preferencialmente Híbrido – com base em Fortaleza/CE

O primeiro desafio será liderar a frente de People Analytics , reposicionando o uso de dados na área de pessoas. A vaga também envolve a sustentação e evolução de projetos com LLMs já em produção , com planejamento para expansão ao longo do ano. A empresa está em processo de migração da arquitetura de BI para uma estrutura orientada a Data Science , sob diretriz direta da alta gestão.

We are looking for a highly experienced Edge Network Engineer to lead complex edge, network, and cloud platform deployments. This role will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert during onboarding, migrations, and new platform integrations. Success in this role requires exceptional technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and the ability to lead both technical workstreams and customer expectations.
The Edge Network Engineer position provides customer facing network design, implementation, configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocols, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, this role also serves as a Tier 4 escalation point from the global support organization.
Experience with SD-WAN—especially Versa Networks—is a major asset and will elevate your candidacy.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead customer deployments of edge computing infrastructure, cloud integration, and SD-WAN platforms.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for end-to-end implementation activities, including architecture planning, configuration, testing, and go-live support.
  • Work closely with project managers, systems engineers, and customer stakeholders to align on design and timelines.
  • Troubleshoot deployment issues across operating systems, hypervisors, containers, and networks.
  • Develop automation scripts and reusable tooling to improve speed and consistency of deployments within the larger context of the company strategy.
  • Document procedures, configurations, and lessons learned; contribute to internal knowledge bases.
  • Mentor junior engineers and participate in internal enablement and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Participate in periodic customer workshops to review implementation design as needed to support large-scale or complex rollouts.
Qualifications:
  • Extensive experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors (e.g., KVM, VMware).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies; experience with lightweight Kubernetes distributions (e.g., K3s) preferred.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles including routing, VLANs, firewalls, DNS, NAT, Routing protocols and proxies.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing network interfaces, both physical and virtual.
  • Prior experience with SD-WAN deployment and management; Versa SD-WAN experience is a strong plus.
  • Proficiency in using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, iptables, netstat, and other network diagnostic utilities.
  • Experience with cloud service providers such as Azure or AWS, including VM provisioning, datastore configuration, and SSO setup.
  • Comfortable working with REST APIs and using tools like Postman, Swagger, curl, and Python scripts for automation and testing.
  • Awareness of secure deployment principles; familiarity with TPM, encryption, and measured boot is a plus (can be trained internally).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Bash scripting.
  • Experience with tools like ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM platforms for Project/Change/Incident management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document issues, escalate appropriately, and collaborate across teams.
  • Fluent in English
Preferred Background:
  • 5+ years in edge infrastructure deployment, implementation engineering, or similar technical field.
  • Experience supporting or deploying edge orchestration platforms (e.g., Zededa, Azure IoT Edge, AWS Greengrass).
  • Experience with zero-touch provisioning, telemetry pipelines, or site/network architecture at the edge is a plus.

  • Work at the cutting edge of network operations, edge computing/networking, and satellite systems, enabling global connectivity in the most remote and demanding scenarios.

title: EHS Specialist
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

We are currently seeking an EHS Specialist position to support the Country in fulfilling their responsibility in the area of occupational safety and environmental protection.

Areas of Responsibility:

  1. Ensures that all applicable legal and Siemens internal requirements (Corporate, Business Unit) in the area of EHS are implemented and that a certifiable EHS Management System is maintained and effective. Contributes to / supports / leads projects of Global EHS DI SW Roadmap. Adapts, promotes, and implements local and global EHS programs and initiatives and monitors their effectiveness.
  2. Maintains and fosters close interaction with respective Countries' CEOs, Business Units EHS officer, RC BR and Global Health Management Manager and facilities operations teams and other counterparts as required. Frequent interactions with the RC Brazil team for applicable EHS Collaboration engagement opportunities.
  3. Sets and implements Country EHS roadmap based on business strategy and Corporate / Business EHS roadmap.
  4. Plans, implements, and follows up on the audit / assessment / inspections program (including certification audits where applicable).
  5. Management of CIPA: Coordinate the entire electoral process of the CIPA (Internal Commission for Accident and Harassment Prevention) according to the regulations. Coordinate the functioning of the CIPA (Internal Commission for Accident and Harassment Prevention) – meetings, action calendar, improvement proposals, campaigns and SIPAT (Internal Week of Occupational Accident Prevention). Provide CIPA training for new members according to the regulations.
  6. Keep NR4 documents annually archived and available for inspection.
  7. Monitor and coordinate the preparation of PGR / PCMSO / AET (those are mandatory programs – Safety, Health and Ergonomic) with the service provider.
  8. Coordinate all Environmental reporting figures consumption data in collaboration with SRE stakeholders.
  9. Conducts analyses of accidents and health hazards to be used to target specific prevention strategies. Prepares and maintains required documentation of incident reports, statistical analysis to drive continuous improvement process through Behavior Based Safety.
  10. Conducts worksite risk assessments to identify and evaluate safety and health risk and compliance exposures. Develops and implements strategies to reduce or eliminate these risks and exposures.
  11. Coordinate all EHS onboarding and offboarding activities for employees, manage all medical exams, including PPP before 2023 for all terminated employees. Create positions and hierarchies for the admission process within SOC (health system), including updates when necessary.
  12. Drives administrative and engineering controls to eliminate hazards in the facility to create a zero-incident workplace.
  13. Ensures adequate EHS-related communication with internal and external stakeholders and authorities.
  14. Ensures an adequate competence management and training system for EHS-related competencies within the country organization.
  15. Ensures and controls EHS-related reporting as to local and Siemens requirements.
  16. Ensures EHS Management System implementation and drives continuous improvement for the Country organization.
  17. Ensures implementation of EHS-related risk management in processes, projects, and products.
  18. Ensures that applicable statutory requirements are identified and accorded to.
  19. Request exam scheduling with the NEXUS provider, guiding the employee through the process. Coordinate with the NEXUS provider the annual campaign for periodic exams (it refers to about 120 exams per year).
  20. Serves as primary key contact for all EHS matters assigned within the area of the EHS responsibilities according to EHS Principles.
  21. Interact with the Health Plan for disease mapping and prevention. Act proactively in health campaigns such as the prevention of seasonal diseases, COVID, etc. and coordinate the annual flu vaccination campaign. Manage all customer EHS supplier requests and provide statistical information when requested.

Additional Responsibilities:

  1. Process for providing PPEs according to need (external or internal supplier, PO, dispatch, system registration, signatures).
  2. Participates in the Siemens Country Crisis Management Team. Serve as the focal point in crisis situations, ensuring the safety and health of employees. This includes collaboration and support to the physical security team to ensure that all control measures are in place to ensure timely identification of corrective actions that need to be implemented.

Experience:

  1. Mid-professional work experience in Environmental Protection, Health Management and Safety (EHS).
  2. Typically, 5+ years of relevant Occupational Safety and Health Administration experience ideally within data center or large-scale engineering environments.
  3. Advanced knowledge of in country legislation and compliance is mandatory.
  4. Knowledge safety and health management.

Education & Trainings:

  1. At least a Bachelor’s Degree, in a related Occupational Safety, Health Administration and/or Environmental Protection field. Degree in technical education and/or EHS related / relevant fields and/or recognized certificates.
  2. Member of one or more of the Professional Organizations in Occupational Safety Health and Environment undertaking a scheme of Continuous Professional Development.
  3. Evidenced training / expertise in the broader spectrum of Brazil EHS regulatory topics.

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

title: Fire Equipment Maintenance Specialist
description:
Summary:

This position will be responsible for providing preventative maintenance and mechanical repair work related to specialized fire vehicles, heavy fire apparatus, other related fire/emergency equipment, various light to heavy trucks up to class 8, and small construction equipment. This position will report to the Vehicle Maintenance Facility (VMF) supervisor. The duties and responsibilities listed below are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all inclusive.

Position Responsibilities:

  1. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.

  2. Complies with all Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements and goals. Provide documentation to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.

  3. Diagnoses, troubleshoots, repairs, and maintains small construction equipment, specialized fire vehicles, heavy fire apparatus, other related fire/emergency equipment, various light to heavy trucks up to Class 8, and small construction equipment.

  4. Corrects deficiencies in components and ancillary equipment.

  5. Performs service, maintenance, repairs and overhauls in accordance with manufacturers’ recommendations.

  6. Performs equipment repairs in response to maintenance requests, in shop or in field locations.

  7. Uses diagnostic procedures and test equipment to identify and correct equipment faults.

  8. Analyzes and diagnoses mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, electric, and electronic faults.

  9. Operates shop equipment including overhead cranes, welders, compressors, presses, grinders, hand tools, and tire servicing equipment.

  10. Operates recovery vehicle and performs recovery functions, sometimes outdoors in extreme environmental conditions.

  11. Performs major maintenance on compressed air foam (CAF) systems units used for aircraft rescue and firefighting (ARFF). These systems contain from 300 to 600 gallons of aircraft firefighting foam expelled by high-pressure compressed air and include 500 lbs. of dry chemical. These systems use “Tri-Max” technology.

  12. Checks operating efficiency of fire vehicles, heavy fire apparatus, and fire mechanical equipment.

  13. Repairs and adjusts engines, transmissions, brake systems, hydraulic systems, water pumps, and accessories.

  14. Ensures pump systems provide appropriate volumes of water at specified pressures during periodic and required annual pump testing.

  15. Tunes engines; cleans, repairs, and replaces carburetors, fuel systems, pumps, strainers, fuel lines, fuel tanks, gauges, and wires; and reconditions electrical systems.

  16. Performs general maintenance of all fire equipment, including oiling and lubricating various components.

  17. Performs heavy vehicle systems and component failure analyses.

  18. Ensures fire apparatus conforms to National Fire Protection Association (N.F.P.A.) standards.

  19. Responds to emergency callouts and mutual aid requests for mechanic services and perform emergency field repairs on fire apparatus and related equipment.

  20. May work day, night or swing shifts depending on operational needs.

  21. Assists other mechanics and members of the VMF team as required.

  22. Maintains thorough and accurate service logs and records of maintenance performed including diagnosis, root cause, labor, and parts in Maximo or other approved methods.

  23. Conducts parts and repair requirements research.

  24. Provides input to supervisor regarding equipment utilization, equipment replacement, and equipment needs.

  25. Provides classroom and hands-on instruction to Antarctic Fire Department personnel pertaining to maintenance and operation of fire apparatus and related equipment.

  26. Assists the VMF supervisor in identifying appropriate training opportunities with a goal of providing succession training for the position.

  27. Keeps tools, equipment, and work area clean, organized, and in good working condition.

  28. Road tests vehicles.

  29. Observes and follows all safety rules and procedures, including wearing required personal safety equipment.

  30. Performs additional duties and projects as assigned.

Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:

  1. High School diploma or GED

  2. At least five (5) years’ experience as an Emergency Vehicle Technician or six (6) years’ experience as a vehicle mechanic with the ability to certify as an Emergency Vehicle Technician, or five (5) years’ experience as a vehicle mechanic with one summer or winter Antarctic deployment working as a light vehicle or heavy equipment technician.

  3. Demonstrated knowledge of methods and tools used in repair and maintenance of fire vehicle apparatus, including diesel engines, fire pumps, hydraulic, electrical, and pneumatic systems.

  4. Demonstrated knowledge of N.F.P.A. standards for commercial and fire vehicles.

  5. Demonstrated knowledge of automotive repairs and maintenance.

Expected Skills and Competencies:

  1. Demonstrated mechanical aptitude.

  2. Ability to operate and drive a variety of fire vehicles and equipment.

  3. Ability to understand, diagnose, and repair modern fire apparatus electrical systems, including computerized engine, transmission, and brake systems.

  4. Knowledge of basic record keeping and work order system procedures.

  5. Working knowledge of diagnostic software as it relates to general automotive fleet, fire apparatus and heavy vehicle equipment.

  6. Basic computer skills using Microsoft Office Suite applications and computerized fleet work order systems.

  7. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment that requires handling multiple tasks at a given time and rapidly adapting to changing priorities and schedules.

  8. Cross-cultural sensitivity with an international perspective.

  9. Excellent organizational and time management skills.

  10. Ability to become an active and functioning member of a team.

  11. Ability to be innovative and be an agent for change.

  12. Strong written and verbal communication skills to facilitate and disseminate information.

  13. Proficiency in lifting and bracing large and heavy parts/equipment with jacks, cranes, floor lift and cribbing is required.

  14. Ability to use mechanic tools and diagnostic equipment with skill and safety.

  15. Ability to follow directions.

  16. Ability to establish and maintain effective work relationships with those contacted in the performance of required duties.

Preferred:

  1. EVT Certifications, ASE certifications, and dealership certifications are a plus.

  2. Two years training at a technical school is highly desirable.

  3. Relevant overseas automotive mechanical experience is preferred.

  4. Hands-on experience working with equipment manufactured by Oshkosh, Pierce or E-One, Ford, International, and Freightliner is highly desirable.

  5. Previous USAP experience or experience with remote polar operations is preferred.

  6. Knowledge of principles and processes involved in supporting vehicle maintenance functions at an overseas facility.

  7. Knowledge of sound mechanical practices as applied to commercial and special-purpose equipment, to include electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems is preferred.

Physical and/or Other Requirements:

  1. Willingness and ability to deploy to Antarctica for extended periods.

  2. Successful completion of Medical and Dental examinations required by the NSF for deployment to Antarctica.

  3. Successful completion of drug screening and background check required by employer.

  4. Successful completion of Federal Background Check required by the NSF.

  5. Must be willing and able to lift and move items, parts, assemblies, and equipment up to the safety regulation maximum as required by the position.

  6. Must be willing and able to perform physical activities including heavy lifting, climbing in and out of equipment, crawling, and working outdoors in extreme cold as required by the position.

  7. Must participate in community programs, such as “house-mouse” (chores), “daisy-picking” (cleaning-up around the station), recycling efforts & safety objectives.

Descrição da empresa

A Inspetoria São João Bosco (ISJB) é parte de uma instituição global com presença em diversos países do redor do mundo, os Salesianos . Em todo planeta, os Salesianos são conhecidos por suas obras educacionais, de ação social e evangelização , e, no Brasil, somos divididos em inspetorias, organizadas por divisão geográfica.

A ISJB é mantenedora de unidades nos estados de Minas Gerais, Espírito Santo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Distrito Federal e Tocantins e nosso Centro Inspetorial (a sede administrativa) se localiza em Belo Horizonte/MG. São 14 comunidades canônicas, que gerenciam as obras, que se dividem nos seguintes segmentos de atuação:

SEGMENTO EDUCAÇÃO

A ISJB é responsável por 12 Escolas Salesianas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que atuam desde a educação infantil até o ensino médio e um Centro Universitário, o UniSales, na cidade de Vitória/ES. Uma educação católica de excelência, que se utiliza das mais avançadas técnicas pedagógicas contemporâneas.

SEGMENTO AÇÃO SOCIAL

A ISJB mantém em sua área de atuação geográfica 4 CESAMs, que são referência nacional na aprendizagem juvenil profissionalizante, além de 5 Centros Juvenis, 1 Pré-vestibular social, 20 Oratórios Festivos e 3 Oratórios diários. É o legado de Dom Bosco, e o seu reconhecido método preventivo em ação, para quem mais precisa.

SEGMENTO PASTORAL (EVANGELIZAÇÃO)

Somos Salesianos de Dom Bosco, e na esfera pastoral, a ISJB mantém 12 paróquias e 6 capelas salesianas, além de suas obras de formação religiosa (um aspirantado, um pré-noviciado e um noviciado), uma Casa de Retiro e um Centro de Documentação.

Localizado em Belo Horizonte/MG, é responsável pela administração das obras em escala nacional, e onde estão sediados os escritórios administrativos da inspetoria.

Title: Technology Value Realization Specialist

Description:

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Technology Value Realization Specialist to join our Technology Strategy & Planning Department (TSPD).

TSPD’s mission is to provide high-impact leadership and support across the technology life-cycle, from strategy setting to value realization and sustainable growth, and partner with corporate and business stakeholders to integrate new technologies into the company’s strategies and investment plans.

Your primary role is to play a central part in the corporate stage-gate and value realization process. You will provide leadership in the implementation, governance and sustainable capability needed to support full integration, application and continuous improvement of the technology stage-gate process.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Support the company-wide roll-out of the Technology Realized Value (TRV) KPI validation and reporting process in partnership with Upstream, Downstream, Finance & Technology Organizations.
  • Manage and oversee the technology stage-gate process, including ongoing implementation to support R&D, technology development, demonstration and deployment, and transition to operations in order to enable value realization from technology investments.
  • Provide leadership for scientists, engineers, and other business/functional specialists to enable de-risking and go/no go decisions for R&D projects, ensuring technical-commercial readiness prior to deployment and value realization.
  • Serve as an internal consultant for project teams on the development of robust business cases, deployment and value realization strategies, including partnering with technical, commercial and business leads to implement robust commercial review process to maximize financial return and strategic impact from R&D projects.
  • Assess technology stage-gate practices and related activities across the Company, in order to maintain high-standards and compliance with the Corporate Technology Development General Instructions.
  • Partner with R&D staff and stakeholders in technology, business and supporting functions, in order to ensure alignment across all areas and to support a smooth transition and adoption of the enhanced technology management processes.
  • Provide expert guidance to project teams and technology/executive management on related activities, including business case development, IP and commercial strategy, supply chain development, deployment plans, business models, value realization and related techno-economics.

Minimum Requirements

  • You must hold a Bachelor degree in Science or Engineering. An advanced degree (MBA/Finance) is highly desirable.
  • You should have at least 10 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years of experience in commercial technology development and value realization, preferably with some experience in oil and gas, chemicals and related industries.
  • You must possess subject matter expertise, business acumen and effective change management skills.
  • You will be able to demonstrate experience with Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) systems, such as Planisware, Accolade, Clarity and similar software applications.
  • A proven track record of successfully working with multi-cultural, cross-functional teams, and developing productive working relationships.
  • Experience with Operation Excellence (OE) process development, implementation, including continuous improvement is also required.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
